text:
Ava Li: thinking out loud — i'm trying to design a ‘prefetch fairness allocator’ for prefix-KV. idea: give each tenant a small pool of soft credits for prefetches that refill slowly, plus a tiny global emergency reserve. goals: avoid noisy neighbors hogging prefetch while keeping tail latency low for bursts. thoughts?
Marcus Green: short take: soft credits + global reserve sounds right. main danger is complex handoff/lease revocation races when you demote soft residency. we should keep the eviction path simple.
Priya Rao: can we be explicit about alloc rules? e.g. weighted token-bucket per tenant, but allow borrow from global reserve up to X tokens/tenant per minute. borrow costs increase priority penalty. pseudocode:
```
if tenant.credits > 0: allocate(prefetch)
else if global.reserve > 0 and tenant.borrowed < borrow_limit:
  tenant.borrowed += 1; global.reserve -= 1; allocate(prefetch)
else: reject_prefetch -> fall back to synchronous read
```
That keeps behavior predictable.
Chen Wu: major correctness concern: what happens if we soft-evict a prefix while there are in-flight requests that expect KV residency (read-after-write or streaming ops)? we need an epoch/lease attached to residency entries so in-flight requests detect eviction and either retry or wait. otherwise we risk returning stale or missing embeddings.
Ava Li: yep — propose two-phase eviction: mark soft-evict (still served) and start grace window tied to inflight_count. if inflight_count > 0, extend grace TTL. after grace ends, promote to hard-evict and release memory. that avoids races without global coordination.
Marcus Green: Implementation notes: mark should be cheap (bit flip + epoch++). checks on read path: if entry.marked && entry.epoch != req.epoch -> trigger fetch-or-wait. keep path non-blocking: try fetch async, return fallback if timeout.
Priya Rao: ops/telemetry plan: add metrics: `prefetch_credit_use_by_tenant`, `global_reserve_borrows`, `soft_evict_count`, `handoff_latency_ms`, `prefetch_reject_rate`. alert if borrow rate > 0.5 for >5m.
Chen Wu: rollout plan: feature flag gated, enable on 1 region/canary pool, run A/B: group A legacy prefetch, group B credits+reserve. compare p95/p99 tail latency, prefetch hit rate, and token cost per request. also run smoke tests for RA/W invariants.
Priya Rao: quick cadence: land RFC spike -> experiment flag -> canary (2 weeks) -> widen if no regs. add unit tests for epoch/mark transitions and e2e for in-flight extend TTL.
deploy-bot: deploy:kv-prefetch-algo v2 -> canary started :rocket:
Ava Li: ok i'll draft a short RFC with diagrams and the minimal API changes (entry.marked, entry.epoch, tenant.credit_config) and include the rollout gates. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Marcus Green: SGTM. i can pair on the epoch tests tomorrow.
Priya Rao: i'll own the dashboards + alerts.
Chen Wu: i'll prototype graceful demote logic in the slab layer.
Ava Li: perfect — i'll post the RFC link here when ready.
